tools.name: find_best
tools.description: Given a plain-language task (e.g. 'web search', 'scrape a page to markdown', 'BTC price'), returns the recommended paid API endpoint and ranked alternatives with price per call, reliability score and real usage. Use before paying for an unfamiliar x402 API.

tools.name: compare_category
tools.description: Full ranked comparison of paid endpoints in one category. Call list_categories for valid ids.

tools.name: check_endpoint
tools.description: Score, live probe history, price and usage for one endpoint URL Haggly tracks.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories Haggly compares, with endpoint counts and the cheapest price per call.
